Model performance

Measured pilot: 50 spelling tests and 50 word-order tests per translation direction, using the same 400 queries for every method. Scores include exact matching and rejected queries. Transformer rows measure TF-IDF + quantized model reranking with CPU inference; browser output may vary slightly.

Rank-1: correct translation at the first returned entry. Hit@5: correct translation within five entries. Coverage: queries receiving a result. Rejections count as incorrect. Each aggregate uses 200 queries per test. **Known-entry lookup checks 400 unchanged indexed sources; it does not measure generalization.
